episodes.synopsis: When 15-year-old Asa loses her parents to an accident, she's taken in by her strange aunt, Makio.
episodes.title: Overflow

episodes.synopsis: Makio's friend visits to meet Asa. Later, Makio meets with an old acquaintance for some advice.
episodes.title: Wrap

episodes.synopsis: Makio and Asa return home to sort through her family's belongings, and Asa attends middle school graduation.
episodes.title: Discard

episodes.synopsis: Asa begins high school as Makio grapples with the new responsibilities of being her guardian.
episodes.title: Cower

episodes.synopsis: Asa struggles to choose an extracurricular activity as she recalls old memories of Minori.
episodes.title: Decide

episodes.synopsis: As Asa enters summer break, Makio finds herself growing closer with Kasamachi-kun.
episodes.title: Overlap

episodes.synopsis: As Makio weighs what to do with Minori's journal, she meets Emiri's mother and learns of Minori's past.
episodes.title: Leave in Writing

episodes.synopsis: After discovering Minori's journal, Asa begins skipping school, prompting Makio to search for her.
episodes.title: Wander

episodes.synopsis: Asa returns to school and tries her hand at writing lyrics, while Makio battles writer’s block.
episodes.title: Intersect

episodes.synopsis: Asa continues working on original lyrics while her classmates face struggles of their own at school.
episodes.title: Bind

episodes.synopsis: With Valentine's Day approaching and no Valentine, Asa asks others about their plans in hopes of chocolate.
episodes.title: Set Free

episodes.synopsis: Asa auditions as her band's vocalist. Meanwhile, Makio and Michiko meet up while Kasamachi runs into Tono.
episodes.title: Find

episodes.synopsis: A chance meeting at the station leads Asa to invite Chiyo to her band club’s upcoming performance.
episodes.title: Morning Is Here
